releaseNotes: Strengthens the offline original-language word-study library: consolidates duplicate lexical entries into 90 unique terms, expands the contextual studies of Ruach, Logos and Metanoia, adds Agathosyne, Tov and Kerygma, and validates declared language against the original script. Consolidates 22 duplicate verse-response records into 173 unique Scripture references and makes duplicate references a blocking integrity error. Scripture references are checked against the bundled KJV. Morphology remains explicitly unasserted unless verified for the exact verse.
